name: Quéntar (Spain)
description: Vertically divided, the hoist dark blue with the crowned municipal arms of Quéntar (a flower and crescents on blue above a bridge, with the motto TÚ SERÁS MI LEAL AMIGO), the fly divided horizontally yellow over white.
history: Municipal flag of Quéntar; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Quéntar arms — flower and crescents above a bridge, with motto
